capabilities.title: Window geometry + movable shell
capabilities.requirement: Window opens at a sane default size/position (centered or remembered); the frameless custom titlebar is a working drag region so the window moves.
capabilities.observed_gap: Opens tiny, pinned to the top-left corner, cannot be moved (dragging the titlebar does nothing).

verification.acceptance: Launched window opens at the configured default size and centered/remembered position and is movable by dragging the titlebar (window position delta > 0).
verification.ref: pulse-app/tests/window_chrome_config.rs::default_capability_grants_window_drag_and_controls + ::main_window_opens_centered; pulse-app/tests/unit_window_geometry.rs (5 remembered-position roundtrip tests); capability ACL compile-validated by tauri-build (allow-start-dragging/allow-minimize/allow-toggle-maximize embedded). Headful drag-delta e2e deferred to P-075/P-076.

capabilities.notes: Premise correction (2026-06-29 /phase): the data-tauri-drag-region markup already exists (chunk #24, rendered by the boot window); F1 movability is achieved by granting core:window:allow-start-dragging (silently rejected under core:default), not by building a drag region. Scope also grants allow-minimize/allow-toggle-maximize (same root cause; close -> P-063) and adds remembered free position (Rust-side; no allow-set-position). Full headful tauri-driver drag-delta e2e carried to the Epoch-4 e2e/Conductor suite (P-075/P-076); this chunk proves via capability grant + boot smoke + unit fallback tests.

capabilities.title: Window size constraints
capabilities.requirement: Enforce a minimum size plus a sensible aspect-ratio constraint for the glance widget.
capabilities.observed_gap: Free-resizes to any dimensions; no min-size, no aspect lock; looks absurd when stretched.

verification.acceptance: Attempting to resize below the min-size is clamped; the aspect ratio stays within the configured bound.
verification.ref: pulse-app/tests/unit_window_constraints.rs (6 aspect-band clamp tests: in_band/min_size_floor/near_edges/too_wide/too_tall/degenerate) + pulse-app/tauri.conf.json minWidth/minHeight (OS-enforced min-size, both windows) + window::clamp_to_aspect_bounds wired into on_window_event Resized arm; live headful resize-delta e2e carried to P-076

capabilities.notes: Scope (2026-06-29 /phase): Tauri 2.11/tao 0.35 has NO native aspect-ratio API, so min-size is OS-enforced via tauri.conf.json minWidth/minHeight (both windows per Q2) and aspect is a WindowEvent::Resized band-clamp on the compact-widget (pure clamp_to_aspect_bounds helper + unit tests, re-entrancy-guarded). In-chunk proof = static config + unit tests; the live headful resize-delta e2e carries to P-076 (mirrors the P-061 headful-drag-delta CARRY).

capabilities.title: Predictable close + honest tray
capabilities.requirement: Window-close quits or minimizes-to-tray with a clear still-running indication; the dashboard is closable; the tray is the single honest running surface.
capabilities.observed_gap: The dashboard cannot be closed; X and taskbar-close do not quit; the process keeps running (only Tray->Quit or a kill stops it).

verification.acceptance: Window-close keeps minimize-to-tray AND fires a clear first-close "still running in the tray" OS notification exactly once per session (suppressed when notifications_enabled=false); the dashboard window genuinely closes (hides); tray Quit terminates the process. Proven via unit tests (first-close idempotency + notifications_enabled gating) + the P-078 xtask self-verify clean-quit assertion; the full headful X-click close-interaction e2e is deferred to P-076.
verification.ref: pulse-app/tests/unit_close_signpost.rs (4 truth-table tests: notifications_enabled x already-shown) + cargo xtask self-verify (real-app clean quit, zero orphan)

capabilities.notes: Premise correction (research-corrects-intent, /phase 2026-06-29): the observed_gap 'cannot be closed / X does not quit' is the SYMPTOM of an unsignposted hide-to-tray — close already does prevent_close()+hide() (chunk #24, window.rs:100-124, wired at main.rs:1021), the arch Tray-icon-policy default. The real gap is the MISSING 'still running' signpost; the OUTCOME (predictable, signposted close) is unchanged. Fix = first-close OS notification gated on Settings.notifications_enabled, NOT a new close mechanism. The working-route line + intent.md F3 stay as historical source. See chunks/2026-06-29-predictable-close-self-verify/{scope,plan}.md.

capabilities.title: Suppress browser context menu
capabilities.requirement: No default WebView2 menu (Back/Refresh/Save-as/Print/Inspect) in a production build; suppressed app-wide or replaced with an app menu.
capabilities.observed_gap: Right-click anywhere shows the default WebView2 menu (Back/Refresh/Save-as/Print/Inspect) with zero app meaning.

verification.acceptance: A real contextmenu event dispatched in PROD mode (vitest fireEvent.contextMenu) on a non-editable element is preventDefault-ed by the installed app-wide handler (no default WebView2 menu); on an editable input/textarea it is NOT prevented (native menu + copy/paste preserved); in dev mode the handler is absent (right-click -> Inspect kept). Live headful right-click folded into P-076.
verification.ref: pulse-app/ui/src/hooks/use-suppress-browser-chrome.test.tsx::useSuppressBrowserChrome (prevents context menu on non-editable in PROD; keeps it on editable inputs; not installed in dev)

capabilities.notes: Linked at /phase 2026-06-30. App.tsx-mounted use-suppress-browser-chrome hook (PROD-gated; editable-exempt per the /phase P4 user decision 'Exempt text fields'). Affordance-level proof = webview vitest dispatching a real contextmenu event; the live headful tauri-driver right-click CARRIES to P-076 (mirrors the P-061 drag-delta / P-062 resize-delta headful CARRYs).

capabilities.title: Canvas not a browser image
capabilities.requirement: The halo/canvas is not treated as a saveable/draggable browser image.
capabilities.observed_gap: Clicking the halo/canvas triggers the browser's save-image interaction.

verification.acceptance: A real dragstart on a <canvas> (vitest, PROD mode) and a contextmenu on a <canvas> are both preventDefault-ed (no drag-to-save, no Save-image-as), and the global `canvas { -webkit-user-drag: none; user-select: none }` rule covers all 5 canvas hosts. Live headful interaction folded into P-076.
verification.ref: pulse-app/ui/src/hooks/use-suppress-browser-chrome.test.tsx::useSuppressBrowserChrome (prevents drag-to-save on a canvas in PROD) + pulse-app/ui/src/styles/tokens.css global canvas user-drag/select rule (verified emitted into dist/tokens.css)

capabilities.title: Widget-to-dashboard navigation
capabilities.requirement: An explicit in-app affordance expands the glance widget into the full dashboard (not tray-only).
capabilities.observed_gap: The full dashboard is reachable ONLY via the tray Open menu; the widget has no affordance to open it.

verification.acceptance: Activating the in-widget affordance opens or focuses the full dashboard window.

capabilities.title: Live-only service truth
capabilities.requirement: Show only currently-live services; persisted/stale service_registry entries are hidden or clearly marked historical/inactive; recency labels never imply liveness that is not there.
capabilities.observed_gap: On a fresh start with zero live telemetry the constellation still renders ~6-7 service dots plus a 'Listening - last span - just now' tooltip (persisted registry shown as if live).

verification.acceptance: With zero live telemetry the constellation/list shows no live services (persisted entries hidden or labeled historical); no recency label implies current liveness.

capabilities.title: Anomaly surfacing
capabilities.requirement: Errors/anomalies surface to the TOP of the Traces table and/or are visually flagged and filterable; the user sees what is wrong first.
capabilities.observed_gap: Traces sorts by latency ascending, so the single erroring service (payment-service, 2500ms, 100% errors) sits at the very bottom off-screen; the visible top is all-healthy.

verification.acceptance: With a mixed dataset, erroring/anomalous services appear at the top (or are flagged) and are filterable; the top row is not all-healthy when errors exist.

capabilities.title: Legible labeled constellation
capabilities.requirement: Each constellation dot is identifiable (name on/near it or on hover) with health/severity clearly encoded.
capabilities.observed_gap: The dots are fuzzy unlabeled blue blobs with no names and no glanceable health.

verification.acceptance: Each rendered dot exposes its service name (label or hover) and a health/severity-encoded color.

capabilities.title: Plain-language connection status
capabilities.requirement: A human-readable status states sources connected / telemetry arriving / buffer state (e.g. 'Receiving from 5 services - ~540 spans/s - buffer 2 min / 10 min').
capabilities.observed_gap: Nowhere does the UI state, in words, how many sources are connected, whether telemetry is arriving, or the buffer state.

verification.acceptance: A visible status line reports connected-source count, ingest rate, and buffer fill in plain language.

capabilities.title: Self-explaining empty states
capabilities.requirement: Metrics/Logs (and other empty surfaces) explain themselves with an actionable hint.
capabilities.observed_gap: The Metrics and Logs tabs are blank with no explanation (the demo injector sent only traces, but the UI does not say so).

verification.acceptance: Empty Metrics/Logs surfaces render an explanatory message with an actionable hint (e.g. point an OTLP exporter at the port).

capabilities.title: Investigate actions functional
capabilities.requirement: Each Investigate action (diagnose latency outlier / find error correlation / trace failed request / summarize service health) runs a real LLM/MCP-backed analysis with visible progress and a result; failures surface, never silent.
capabilities.observed_gap: The Investigate modal opens and the snapshot generates correctly, but the 4 action buttons do NOTHING on click (no result, no feedback) even with live data.

verification.acceptance: Clicking each of the 4 Investigate actions produces a visible progress state and a result (or a surfaced error), never a silent no-op.
verification.notes: Acceptance proven by the deterministic-L4 backend integration suite (4 actions yield a result reproducibly; unknown id -> Validation; runner/parse errors surface) + the InvestigationModalForm vitest suite (click -> aria-busy -> result panel / role=alert error). The full tauri-driver button-click e2e is folded into P-076 (integration UX e2e).

capabilities.title: Deterministic env-gated L4 mode
capabilities.requirement: An env/flag-gated deterministic L4 mode (canned L4Output, no GPU/3B; reuse the StubInferenceRunner pattern) so the digest->L4->incident path completes reproducibly for demos/tests/external verification.
capabilities.observed_gap: A real retry-storm produced NO incident; the digest->L4->incident chain never completes because the L4/LLM step is degraded/fragile.

verification.acceptance: With the deterministic L4 env/flag set, a seeded digest yields a deterministic L4Output and a created incident, reproducibly, with no GPU/model.

capabilities.title: Tier1 incident-path reliability under load
capabilities.requirement: A sustained identical-fingerprint hard-signal storm yields exactly ONE incident, reproducibly. The triggering cue must thread cadence->digest so the digest->L4->incident chain completes; storm coalescing + incident dedup ensure exactly one.
capabilities.observed_gap: The triggering cue is dropped at the cadence->digest boundary (assemble(mode, None, ...)), so create_incident_from_l4_output returns early and a real storm produced NO incident. The earlier TIER1_QUEUE_CAP=3 / ~4s-L4-latency framing was falsified: the LwwQueue is unused on the L4 path (drain_all has zero production callers).

verification.acceptance: A sustained identical-fingerprint storm (>=100 events) drives the cue->cadence->digest->deterministic-L4 path to exactly ONE incident, reproducibly (not zero, not many).

capabilities.notes: Premise-correction (research-corrects-intent at /phase 2026-06-28): the original requirement/observed_gap/acceptance were premised on an 'elastic queue / TIER1_QUEUE_CAP=3 drops 75%' mechanism that phase-3 research falsified. Real cause = un-threaded cue; outcome (one reliable storm incident) unchanged. See chunks/2026-06-28-tier1-incident-path-reliability/scope.md.

capabilities.title: Conductor e2e + delegated-timing verification
capabilities.requirement: With the deterministic L4 mode (P-073), Conductor drives telemetry -> a known incident -> MCP read-back, proving end-to-end incident content-fidelity plus the 4 delegated timing caps P-025 (halo hue <=2s) / P-027 (constellation discovery <=5s) / P-037 (report render <=2s) / P-045 (counter refresh <=1s).
capabilities.observed_gap: Pulse delegated 4 timing caps plus the e2e to Conductor, but Conductor is blocked while incidents are non-deterministic (LLM-gated).

verification.acceptance: Conductor drives a deterministic incident and reads it back via MCP, asserting e2e content-fidelity plus P-025 <=2s / P-027 <=5s / P-037 <=2s / P-045 <=1s.
